{{Top|leg}}
'''FiNet''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network that recorded electronic financial transactions on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The FiNet&mdash;standing for Financial Net&mdash;could be accessed by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[Finance Retrieval and Net Investigations droid]].<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
